run.question: How does Python code in this plugin share modules across its trees — scripts/ (incl. the hyphenated scripts/afk-config.py), hooks/lib/, skills/*/scripts/, adapters/*/ — and how does bash code call Python helpers? For each cross-tree import that exists today: the importing file, the imported module, and the mechanism (sys.path insert, importlib by path, relative package import, PYTHONPATH, subprocess via afk-python). Which modules are already imported from more than one tree (shared libraries), where do they live, and what conventions do they follow (location, naming, tests location, header docs)? How do the forge adapters (adapters/forge/github/forge.sh, adapters/forge/gitlab/forge.sh) and hooks/lib/config.sh obtain values computed in Python (afk-config.py export-shell, resolve, other)? Does the guard (hooks/protected-branch-guard.py, hooks/lib/protected_branch_guard.py) import anything from scripts/ or skills/? Which test runners and locations cover hooks/lib and scripts (hooks/tests, others)?
